tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Seekridge Navy, the primary brand colour (guideline). Logo, headlines on marketing, primary buttons in light theme. 11.6:1 with white.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Darker navy from the reversed logo's ground. Dark brand panels, hover state of navy buttons.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Meridian Gold, the secondary brand colour (guideline). The gold summit point in the logomark, accents, rules, chart highlight. Never body text on light grounds (3.05:1 on white): only as a fill, or with ink text on it (5.6:1).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: The gold used in the reversed logo on navy. Accent and primary action on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ink-raw
tokens.usage: Ink, the guideline's darkest neutral. Use the semantic 'ink' token in UI.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Slate, the guideline's mid neutral. Disabled text, decorative icons, control borders on white (3.58:1). Not for body text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper, the guideline's light neutral. Page ground in light theme; text on navy.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: Paper. Dark: a deep navy-black added by the design system.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs. Flat, bordered by 'line'; no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, code blocks, read-only fields (design system addition).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and dividers (guideline's card border). Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outlined buttons: 3:1 or more against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (17:1 light, 11.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, table metadata (6.0:1 on white, 6.6:1 on dark surface). From the guideline's swatch-sheet labels.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. Light: Navy, as the guideline says. Dark: gold-light, because navy disappears on navy grounds.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on 'action' (11.6:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand accent: the top data point in an evidence trail, eyebrow rule, active tab underline. Never a status colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status good (guideline value in light). Icons, dots, chart marks only: 3.35:1 on white, so text uses 'good-ink'.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and badge text on 'good-bg' (4.75:1 light, 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Success badge and alert ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status warning (guideline value in light), deliberately distinct from gold. Icons and marks only: 2.79:1 on white.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on 'warning-bg' (4.6:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning badge and alert ground.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Status critical (guideline value). Error icons and field borders; 4.8:1 on white, so it can carry text too.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on 'critical-bg' (5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: critical-bg
tokens.usage: Error badge, alert and invalid-field ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. One per page. Never all-caps; text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every moment shows the transaction, customer and market data behind it.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pushes moments into your existing CRM via API.
styles.usage: Running text, emails. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Based on 6 data points from 3 sources.
styles.usage: Dense UI text, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a heading: the only place all-caps is allowed. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures, dates, IDs. Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in columns.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source citations and footnotes. Never prose.

spacing.note: 4px base grid (design system addition; the guideline defines no spacing scale).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, badge padding (horizontal), tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding x 0.85, table cell padding (vertical), label-to-field gap is space-2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, table cell padding (horizontal), form field stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between form sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section spacing in pages and documents.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing, hero padding.

radius.note: Soft, modern corners for screens: small radii on controls, 16px on cards, pills only for chips, facts and badges.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands (masthead, footer).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: List markers, checkboxes, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small image frames.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, tables, the masthead map tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and showcase frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: nav, fact chips, badges, source chips.

shadow.note: The brand uses hairline borders, not shadows. One shadow exists for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, buttons: always.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs that float above content. Keep the hairline border too.

borderWidth.note: Line weights shared by borders, icons and the logomark's construction.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card and table borders, dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings, active tab underline, eyebrow rule.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke at 24px (guideline: 1.5–2px, no fills).

canvas.note: Fixed canvases for social and video (design system addition).

tokens.name: canvas-carousel-w
tokens.usage: LinkedIn carousel and single-post width (4:5 portrait, 1080 × 1350).

tokens.name: canvas-carousel-h
tokens.usage: LinkedIn carousel and single-post height.

tokens.name: canvas-video-w
tokens.usage: Product video, 16:9 master (1920 × 1080, 30 fps).

tokens.name: canvas-video-h
tokens.usage: Product video master height.

tokens.name: canvas-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on carousel and video canvases: no text or logo closer to any edge.

tokens.name: canvas-margin-caption
tokens.usage: Video: keep burnt-in captions and lower thirds this far above the bottom edge (player controls).
